thread:
omar: Hey finance, quick one-- stayed in an Airbnb for a week in Lima. Corp card charged an extra "cleaning fee" of PEN 120 after checkout (host messaged me saying cleaner found garbage). The original booking showed PEN 80 cleaning, but this PEN 120 appears on the final card post. Should I file for reimbursement or will we dispute?

kelly: do you have the Airbnb invoice and the host message thread? if the host added a damage/cleaning charge via Airbnb resolution center with an itemized reason we can reimburse. if the charge is a post-settlement adjustment from the processor we might dispute. can you upload docs? :mag:

omar: uploaded the Airbnb receipt (shows PEN 80 cleaning) and a screenshot of the host message asking for PEN 40 extra for "deep clean" plus the Ramp txn (last4 6677). Ramp txn id RMP-993311. host didn't open an official resolution, just DM'd.

expense-bot: Reminder: attach (1) Airbnb invoice, (2) host messages or resolution center thread, (3) Ramp transaction screenshot. If host hasn't filed a formal resolution, finance requires either a resolution request screenshot OR manager sign-off to reimburse. Use expense title "LIM - Airbnb - 2026-08-21".

julia: thanks @omar. Two things: 1) ask the host to submit a resolution request in Airbnb (that gives us an official itemized claim), OR 2) if they refuse, we can reimburse you now with manager approval and then open vendor recovery. Travel policy says incidental cleaning fees are reimbursable if documented and under PEN 200; anything above or discretionary host claims require manager review.

ben: +1. because the Airbnb invoice doesn't match the card charge, we need the host to raise the charge via Airbnb so we have a transaction record against the booking. If host won't, we can do a temporary reimbursement but we will flag it as "host dispute" and try to recover. Also confirm whether the extra was actually charged to the corp card (not a pending auth).

omar: confirmed final posted charge is PEN 200 on card (booking 80 + post-charge 120). I already messaged the host asking them to file via resolution center and cc'd me. Host replied "I'll send refund request tomorrow" but hasn't submitted yet.

kelly: ok hold for 48 hours for host to file. If they file, finance will wait for Airbnb docs and then process per policy. If they don't, next steps: manager approval for reimbursement (since PEN 120 > manager auto-approve threshold of PEN 100). Can you tag your manager for sign-off?

omar: pinged my manager (travel mgr) in the DM. manager said they'll approve if host doesn't submit.

expense-bot: Expense queue note: status "awaiting host resolution OR manager approval". If manager approves, attach approval screenshot and we'll process as "temporary reimb - vendor recovery pending". Expected resolution 3-14 business days depending on Airbnb.

travel-ops: small PSA: travelers, keep all host communication inside Airbnb resolution center where possible. Direct DMs are hard for vendor recovery. We'll add a line in the travel tips doc.

julia: if host never files and manager approves, please include a short statement in the expense describing why host didn't use the resolution center. Finance will code as travel->accommodation->cleaning-fee and mark for recovery.

omar: noted. thanks all. I'll wait 48h then update thread.

ben: will keep an eye on Ramp ticket RMP-993311 and can open a card dispute if it looks like a processor-added adjustment without host backing. Will update here.
